notes.title: The Treasures of Montezuma 4 is updated
notes.content:
An update to The Treasure of Montezuma 4 has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart The Treasure of Montezuma 4. Changelog: 

- added support for six languages (Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Swedish, Dutch)
